summary: Executed 24 backend API tests plus desktop/mobile Playwright flows for products, search, authentication, admin, address checkout, order creation, tracking, cancellation rules, and responsive behavior. Backend: 19/24 passed. Core authenticated shopping flow works, but five backend defects and three significant frontend defects remain.

critical.issue: Malformed ObjectId such as 'not-an-object-id' returns 500 Internal Server Error. Backend log confirms uncaught bson.errors.InvalidId.
No brute-force lockout: six consecutive bad-password attempts all returned 400; requirement expects lockout after five failures.
Credentialed response uses Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * instead of an explicit allowed origin while Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is true.
A foreign/non-owned address ID returns 404 but first clears every default address belonging to the requester, leaving that user with no default.
A valid but nonexistent order ID returns 200 'Order status updated' rather than 404 because update matched_count is ignored.

ui_bugs.issue: When an unauthenticated shopper proceeds from the cart and opens sign-in, the auth modal renders underneath the cart's full-screen overlay. Normal click on auth-email-input times out because the cart overlay intercepts pointer events, so checkout login is blocked.

Status update succeeds and the dropdown persists, but no success toast appears. App imports and calls sonner toast but never mounts a Toaster in index.js/App.js; this affects all success/error notifications.
At 390px neither login nor Orders navigation is visible, making authentication and order tracking unreachable through the mobile UI. The Bag control is also clipped off the right edge.

integration_issues.issue: PATCH status integration succeeds, but the required user-facing toast is absent because no Sonner Toaster is mounted.
Auth state flow is invoked, but equal z-index full-screen layers and DOM order make the auth form non-interactive beneath the cart overlay.

issues: Logo wraps to three lines and consumes excessive width.
Bag button is clipped beyond the right viewport edge.
Login and Orders controls are hidden with no mobile-menu replacement.
Search placeholder is visibly truncated, although the secondary search itself is correctly below the navbar.

action_items: Close or lower the cart overlay before opening auth, or give the auth modal a higher stacking layer so checkout login inputs are actionable.
Mount the Sonner Toaster once at the application root and retest admin and checkout notifications.
Add a usable mobile auth/orders menu and fix navbar overflow at 390px.
Validate ObjectId route parameters and return 404/422 instead of 500.
Implement five-attempt login throttling/lockout and configure explicit CORS origins.
Verify address ownership before unsetting defaults, preferably with a transaction/conditional update.
Check Mongo update matched_count in order status updates and return 404 when absent.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1,874 lines, far above the 700-line maintainability threshold; split auth, cart/checkout, catalog, orders, and layout into focused components/hooks.
App.js retains duplicate/dead admin product state and handlers while AdminPanel.jsx implements the same functionality, creating DRY and maintenance risk.
Product and user-data API failures are silently swallowed, allowing mock/stale UI without an error state.
Address, order, and auth Pydantic models only use unconstrained strings/dicts; add email, password, phone, pincode, nonempty items, positive quantity/amount, and structured address validation.
Several interactive controls still lack data-testid attributes, including address Set default/Remove, multiple admin product fields, reset filters, wishlist actions, and footer actions.
Order numbers use second-resolution timestamps and can collide under concurrent order creation.

Mongo verification passed: admin password hash starts with $2b$ and users.email has a unique index; seed_admin code updates an existing password hash when configured password changes. Secure HttpOnly SameSite=None cookies passed.
seed_data_creation: Backend regression runs created TEST_ users and five TEST orders because the API has no user/order deletion endpoint; address teardown removed API-test addresses. UI E2E created testuser+ui-1785506244@example.com with one saved address and one Order Placed order.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core passes: 12 seeded products/filters/suggestions, cookie auth, unauthenticated 401s, user scoping, default switching, address delete, order create/mine/5-step timeline, admin authorization/status progression, cancellation at Shipped/Out for Delivery/Delivered, owner cancellation before shipping, backend-backed home images, desktop search/QuickView, authenticated address checkout, admin tabs, and responsive vertical timeline. Re-run backend_test.py and specifically retest checkout login layering, visible toasts, and mobile navigation after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: Backend failures come from unguarded ObjectId construction, absent login-attempt state, wildcard CORS configuration, destructive update ordering in set_default_address, and ignoring Mongo update results. Frontend failures come from two equal z-50 full-screen overlays rendered in an order that puts the cart above auth, missing root Toaster mounting, and responsive classes that hide auth/orders without a mobile replacement while the navbar content overflows.
